about.title: About our school
about.intro: A learning community built on curiosity, care and high expectations.

mission.d: To educate confident, creative and compassionate learners who contribute to their community.

vision.d: A school where every child discovers their strengths and is ready for an ever-changing world.

items.d: We ask questions and love finding the answers.

philosophy.text: Learning is most powerful when it is active, connected and meaningful. We teach children how to think, not only what to know, so they grow into adaptable learners for life.
